title: Add host-controlled labelled GridField row editing
body:
GridField now supports a host-selected labelled row editor with per-row static options and host computations. Editable rows recompute emitted values in their final order, while read-only rows preserve their saved values. Stable row keys and normal keyboard/IME handling are retained.

The runtime resolver only accepts options, placeholders, and numeric bounds; it cannot replace column identity, type, computed expressions, or rules. SchemaRenderer keeps these new code-only controls outside authored field metadata while preserving explicit React host inputs. Existing grid/list behavior remains covered, with package/guide documentation and fields/react changesets.

Focused validation: 118 checks pass, fields/react source and test type checks and package builds pass, and the new public example compiles against built declarations. Independent review found no blocking input, deletion, calculation, or permission issue. Cross-product business validation and visual refinements are separate follow-up work. The baseline cross-package test-build ordering issue recorded in PR #3 remains a follow-up; this PR does not claim that all cloud checks are green.
